rule: Verify the presence of a distinctively patterned shell and a laterally compressed carapace when identifying sea turtles, especially Hawksbill turtles.
failure_pattern: The model incorrectly predicted 'Platypus' instead of 'Hawksbill' due to overlooking the distinctive features of the Hawksbill turtle.

rule: Focus on specific unique features of the target class when making predictions, especially when there are visually similar options.
failure_pattern: The model incorrectly predicted 'Llama' instead of 'Emu', despite the presence of clear Emu-specific features.

rule: Prioritize detailed feature analysis over high similarity scores when distinguishing closely related classes.
failure_pattern: The model misclassified a lobster as a crayfish due to overlapping visual features such as pincers and segmentation.
